g.text: 🛡️ RoadSafe AI — Full System Architecture & Data Flow Diagram
Municipality of Dagami, Leyte • Gamified Road Safety Awareness, Traffic Rule Education & Driver Decision-Making System (v2.0 Production)
📱 ANDROID MOBILE CLIENT (Kotlin 2.0 + Jetpack Compose) — Offline-First
• USER: Dagami Drivers, Tricycle Operators, Citizens | • ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN: Dagami MPS Officers
Core Interactive Driver Education & Decision Engines
Local Room SQLite Database (AppDatabase.kt) — 100% Offline Persistence
• Real-Time Online/Offline Network Monitor & Retry Exponential Backoff
• Real-Time Module Lock Listener: listenToModuleSettings() (Instant curriculum toggle)
➔ Dispatches uncommitted local events to Cloud Firestore over secure HTTPS
• Hardware brand, model, Android OS version, IP, UTC timestamps • Severity: LOW, MED, HIGH, CRITICAL
Android Smartphones & Tablets (Android 11 to 15) • Offline/Online Transition • GPS/Location
• Instantaneous bi-directional socket streaming between Cloud and Admin Web SPA
• Zero manual page refresh required • Automatic retry reconnection listeners
Firestore Security Rules & RBAC Access Matrix
• Write validations preventing unauthorized XP inflation or attempt falsification
• Indexed by userId + timestamp DESC | • Unique taker aggregations
• Hosts Admin Single-Page Application (index.html, styles.css, app.js)
• Wireless Fleet Onboarding Portal: download.html with Dynamic Canvas QR
Automated CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions & Gradle Matrix)
1. Trigger: On push / pull request to main branch
2. Runner Environment: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS + JDK 17 (Temurin) + Android SDK 34
3. Build Tool: Gradle 8.11 Daemon (./gradlew assembleRelease / assembleDebug)
4. Validation: KSP Room Schema verification, Compose linting, Unit checks
6. Release Distribution: Pushes direct APK download link to GitHub Releases
7. Auto Deployment: Deploys updated admin web assets to Firebase Hosting
• Real-time connection heartbeats & active device count
🖥️ DAGAMI MPS ADMIN WEB COMMAND CENTER (/admin-web SPA)
• index.html: 12-Tab Responsive Command Dashboard & Sidebar Drawer
• app.js: 4,900+ Lines Vanilla ES6+ & Real-Time Firebase Listeners
• styles.css: Custom CSS3 Tokens | • Chart.js 4.4: Dynamic High-Res Canvases
Chart.js Telemetry & Real-Time Data Visualization Hub
Temporal activity & peak driver testing hours
📊 Taker-Based Evaluation: Unique Drivers vs. Total Attempts
• Instant HTML5 Canvas QR code rendering linked to latest compiled APK release
• Enables instant Over-The-Air deployment to Dagami patrol officers and citizen vehicles
• Hardware: Desktop Dual-Monitor Workstations & Field Tablets (Headquarters)
• Web Browsers: Chrome 120+, Microsoft Edge, Firefox, Safari
• 24/7 Real-Time Municipal Traffic Monitoring and Safety Compliance

svg.text: RoadSafe AI Platform • Built for Municipality of Dagami, Leyte • Production Release v2.0 • 100% Offline-First + Cloud Firestore Sync
